header.running_head: The Lectures of Ameerul Mu'mineen Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA)

blocks.text: Travel lightly (without sins) and you will meet (those who have passed away) because (deceased) people are waiting for those after them. Instil the fear of Allaah into His bondsmen with regard to (abusing) His other bondsmen and lands because you will be questioned even with regard to tracts of land and animals. Obey Allaah and never disobey Him. Seize the opportunity to do good whenever you see it, avoid evil when you see it and remember the time when you were few in number and regarded as weak in the lands." [^1]
His Lecture Concerning the Value of a Person's Tribe

Hadhrat Ali (RA) once delivered a lecture saying, "A man's tribe is more valuable to him than he is to his tribe. If he restrains his hand from (assisting) them, he will be restraining but one hand. However, if they restrain their hands, they will be restraining many hands together with the love, protection and assistance they have to offer him. In fact, it often happens that a person becomes angry with another only because of the tribe he belongs to. I can cite to you so many verses of the Qur'aan in this regard." He then recited the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: لَوْ اَنَّ لِىْ بِكُمْ قُوَّةً اَوْ اٰوِىْۤ اِلٰى رُكْنٍ شَدِيْدٍ
blocks.text: He (Hadhrat Loot (AS)) said, "If only I had some might against you or (if only) I could seek protection from a strong pillar."

Hadhrat Ali (RA) then continued to explain, "The strong pillar is a tribe that Hadhrat Loot (AS) did not have (in the place he resided). I swear by the Being besides Whom there is no deity that after Hadhrat Loot (AS), Allaah sent every Nabi (AS) as a member of a strong tribe." Hadhrat Ali (RA) then recited the following verse with regard to Hadhrat Shu'ayb (AS):
(His people said, 'O Shu'ayb!) we consider you to be a weakling among us.
"This they said because Hadhrat Shu'ayb (AS) was blind. However, they then added:
If it were not for your tribe (who are there to protect you), we would have certainly stoned you (to death).
Hadhrat Ali (RA) said further, "I swear by the Being besides Whom there is no deity that rather than fear the supremacy of their Rabb, these people were in awe of Hadhrat Shu'ayb (AS)'s tribe." [^2]
